dataset_notice: Synthetic prototype evaluation rules only; not official AICTE requirements. Never use these values to make real regulatory decisions.

demo_rules.description: Expiry date before evaluation date => EXPIRED / rectification or review
Issuer source unavailable => VERIFICATION_PENDING, never mark verified
Potential tampering or metadata anomaly => MANUAL_REVIEW, not a fraud verdict
Infrastructure evidence insufficient or inconsistent => additional evidence / official review
Role not authorized => DENY and audit the attempt
Faculty count below configured prototype threshold => MANUAL_REVIEW; threshold is synthetic QA configuration only, not an official AICTE requirement.
